svg.title: A delegated issue becomes a verified pull request
svg.desc: Paws authorizes and assigns work at a specific commit. The agent can ask questions in Linear and repair a candidate after verification. An accepted candidate proceeds through publication and merge guards, with the outcome sent back to Linear.
